question: What alternative forms may the ritual image take?
premises: The image may take the form of Kāla.
The image may take the form of a wheel-rim.
inference: The image may be in the form of Kāla, a wheel-rim, or another form.
uncertainties: kāla-rūpaṃ may refer to Time or to the deity Kāla.
plain_english: It may be in the form of Kāla, or in the form of a wheel-rim, or indeed in another form.
